edges.reason: permit builds the digest using the stored DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.
permit reads and increments per-owner permit nonces.
permit writes the allowance mapping after signature verification.
permit recovers the signer address via ecrecover.
permit authorizes based on a block.timestamp deadline comparison.
transfer mutates balanceOf entries for sender and recipient.
transferFrom decrements allowance when not infinite.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf entries via _transfer.
approve writes the allowance mapping using msg.sender.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
swap calls _safeTransfer which performs a raw token.call that can reenter.
swap invokes _safeTransfer for optimistic outbound transfers.
burn triggers external token.call before reserves are synced.
burn invokes _safeTransfer for both tokens before _update.
swap invokes the arbitrary user-supplied uniswapV2Call callback.
the flash-swap callback can reenter swap or other locked functions.
malicious token code in token.call can reenter swap.
malicious token code in token.call can reenter burn.
skim performs external token.call transfers.
skim calls _safeTransfer to push excess balances.
_safeTransfer is the low-level call primitive that externalizes control.
swap performs unchecked fee multiplication and uint112 casts on collected fees.
_update performs overflow-intended multiplication and accumulator addition.
setFeeTo requires msg.sender == feeToSetter.
setFeeToSetter requires msg.sender == feeToSetter.
setProtocolFee requires msg.sender == feeToSetter.
initialize requires msg.sender == factory.
_update derives blockTimestamp from block.timestamp for pricing.
price accumulator arithmetic is driven by the timestamp delta.
createPair calls initialize on the freshly deployed pair.
createPair deploys the pair via create2 assembly.
mint calls _mintFee before computing liquidity.
mint calls _update at the end to sync reserves.
burn calls _mintFee before burning liquidity.
burn calls _update after token transfers.
swap calls _update after the K invariant check.
sync calls _update with current balances.
initialize reads the factory address to fetch the formula.
initialize writes token0.
initialize writes token1.
initialize sets the formula address from the factory.
initialize writes tokenWeight0.
initialize writes swapFee.
_update writes reserve0 from the new balance.
_update writes reserve1 from the new balance.
_update stores blockTimestampLast.
_update accumulates price0CumulativeLast.
_update accumulates price1CumulativeLast.
_update reads tokenWeight0 for adjusted reserves.
mint lock modifier reads and writes unlocked.
burn lock modifier reads and writes unlocked.
swap lock modifier reads and writes unlocked.
skim lock modifier reads and writes unlocked.
sync lock modifier reads and writes unlocked.
_mintFee reads and resets collectedFee0.
_mintFee reads and resets collectedFee1.
_mintFee reads feeTo to decide whether fees are on.
_mintFee reads protocolFee from the factory.
_mintFee calls the formula for mintLiquidityFee.
_mintFee reads and mints against totalSupply.
swap reads swapFee to compute input fees.
swap increases collectedFee0 with the token0 fee.
swap increases collectedFee1 with the token1 fee.
swap reads tokenWeight0 for the invariant branch.
swap calls formula.ensureConstantValue for weighted pools.
swap reads token0 for outbound transfer and balance checks.
swap reads token1 for outbound transfer and balance checks.
burn reads token0 to compute and send the payout.
burn reads token1 to compute and send the payout.
sync queries token0 balance.
sync queries token1 balance.
sync passes reserve0 into _update.
sync passes reserve1 into _update.
skim reads token0 balance and reserve0.
skim reads token1 balance and reserve1.
skim subtracts reserve0 from the token0 balance.
skim subtracts reserve1 from the token1 balance.
mint reads token0 balance to compute amount0.
mint reads token1 balance to compute amount1.
mint reads totalSupply to compute liquidity.
mint mints balance via _mint for the recipient.
burn reads totalSupply for pro-rata payout.
burn reads balanceOf[address(this)] as burnable liquidity.
createPair appends the new pair to allPairs.
createPair stores the pair under its salt hash.
setFeeTo writes feeTo after the admin check.
setFeeToSetter writes feeToSetter after the admin check.
setProtocolFee writes protocolFee after the admin check.
getCollectedFees returns collectedFee0.
getCollectedFees returns collectedFee1.
getReserves returns reserve0.
getReserves returns reserve1.
getReserves returns blockTimestampLast.
amount0Out parameter flows into the swap output transfer.
amount1Out parameter flows into the swap output transfer.
data parameter flows into the flash-swap callback.
recipient parameter flows into swap outbound transfers.
deadline parameter is used in the permit digest.
deadline parameter is compared against block.timestamp in permit.
value parameter flows into ERC20 transfer balance updates.
_tokenWeight0 parameter configures the pair weighting.
_swapFee parameter configures the pair fee.
amount0In local drives fee accounting and the K check in swap.
amount1In local drives fee accounting and the K check in swap.
balance0Adjusted local is used in the invariant comparison.
timeElapsed local drives the cumulative price update.
liquidity local is minted to the recipient in mint.
